definitions.explanation: The joint connecting the hand to the arm. Literally 'hand neck.'

examples.japanese: {手首|てくび}を{回|まわ}してください。
{手首|てくび}に{時計|とけい}をしています。
examples.english: I'm wearing a watch on my wrist.

examples.japanese: {転|ころ}んで{手首|てくび}を{痛|いた}めてしまいました。
examples.english: I fell and hurt my wrist.

examples.japanese: パソコンを{使|つか}いすぎて{手首|てくび}が{痛|いた}くなりました。{少|すこ}し{休|やす}んだ{方|ほう}がいいですね。
examples.english: My wrist hurts from using the computer too much. I should rest a bit.

notes: {手首|てくび} literally means 'hand-neck,' combining {手|て} (hand) and {首|くび} (neck). This pattern is common for body joints: {足首|あしくび} (ankle, literally 'foot-neck'). The pulse is often taken at the {手首|てくび}.
